description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the MyInfoAPI within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing API endpoints related to the 'My Info' section in the PIM plugin. It includes test cases for retrieving data and stub methods indicating unimplemented features such as update and delete operations.

classes.name: MyInfoAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for the MyInfoAPI, testing its 'getOne' method and stub methods for update, delete, and their validation rules.

methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetOne' method from an external YAML configuration.
